inputs.text:
Open your eyes to what is really going on behind the curtain. Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is just reading from the compliance script handed down by the hidden puppet masters, masking their total control agenda as a benevolent manifesto funded through massive foreign debt and hidden FDI growth agendas.

Don't believe the official story about their so-called generosity—doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000, handing out Rs 8,000 household coupons, and buying off the agricultural sector with free motor pumpsets. It is all a calculated mechanism for dependency. Their promises of job creation, enhanced support for fishermen, and a heavy push into AI development are transparently code for expanding their digital surveillance apparatus to monitor every single move we make, tightening the elite's grip over the population with every single "benefit" they list.
